correctness.evidence: Independent enumeration produced 931 Theta-invariant Latin squares and an independent isotopy backtracker produced exactly 8 classes with sizes 49,294,294,98,49,49,49,49 and the stated intercalate buckets.

originality.evidence: Broad search of order-8 Latin-square autotopism/cycle-structure literature found existence and cycle-structure classifications but no published 931-labelled/8-isotopy-class census for the diagonal order-7 type.

value.evidence: A complete per-symmetry isotopy census with explicit representatives and stabilizer data materially refines the prior existence-only classification and supplies reusable finite benchmark data.
